name: jp-ui-contracts
summary: Japanese UI design contracts for AI agents: DESIGN.md templates, CSS recipes, fixtures and an executable validator.
description: A design contract and validation kit for Japanese interfaces: DESIGN.md templates with base, media, saas, docs and dashboard profiles, Japanese typography and overflow CSS recipes, and a loop of contract, generation, validation, evidence and contract revision. A zero-dependency validator, JSON projection and Playwright-rendered fixtures score results PASS / WARN / FAIL and attribute failures to the contract, profile, fixture, validator or implementation layer.
contains: DESIGN.md templates with base, media, saas, docs and dashboard profiles
zero-dependency contract validator with JSON projection for CI
7 rendered fixtures incl. long paragraphs, mixed-script headings, IME forms, dense tables, mobile wrap
Playwright checks on desktop Chromium at 1440px and a Pixel 7 mobile profile
PASS / WARN / FAIL scorecard; failures attributed to contract, profile, fixture, validator or implementation
v0.2.0 release; CI evidence retained for 14 days
